description: c35 compare pair on the c31 git scratch (main and feature change the same line of app.txt), the OFF copy: git in the action layer. OFF: flags none, the engine runs each git command itself with egdesk_run_command and writes. ON: EGDESK_DECISION_FIRST=on: code builds the git options from the repo files (git status, git diff --stat, git log, git merge <named local branch>), the Decision model picks, EG-Desk's runner runs it under the existing approval rules (the gate decides whether the merge needs the person: a merge that needs approval is the engine path with the result block saying it was not run), the run-conditions arbiter records the conflict from git status --porcelain, and the engine talks ONCE. Three turns on the same scratch: git-status, what-changed, git-merge (a conflict). Run both copies with --decisions into two --out folders, then: node scripts/egdesk-real-engine-timing.mjs compare <off>/records <on>/records --normalize '-off|-on'.
